Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Rain jacket or umbrella (for occasional showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes for beach activities
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented)
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Chargers and adapters for electronics
- Books or e-reader for relaxation time
